summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co Ltd (TSMC) filed a Form 6-K for March 2026, reporting routine items such as insider shareholding changes, asset acquisitions, and bond issuances. No special situation event is identified—no merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or strategic review. The filing details minor changes in board and executive holdings, new fixed-income investments of NT$23.2 billion, and unsecured bond issuances totaling NT$17.2 billion with bullet repayment structures. No material corporate action to watch.
